_comment: Vercel Hobby (free) caps cron frequency at exactly 1 run/day. To ship
the bêta on Hobby without upgrading to Pro ($20/mo) we run every cron
once a day at distinct UTC times. Trade-offs:
- Scheduled publications fire daily at 09:00 UTC (≈11:00 Paris) →
a post scheduled for the rest of the day will go out the FOLLOWING
morning. The UI warns the user about this during the bêta.
- Batch processing runs at 09:30 UTC → batches queued during the day
- Webhook retries fire at 10:00 UTC → up to 24h delay on retry, but
the persistent queue means nothing is lost.
